senses.gloss:
f. (-णा)
1 The nose.
2 The nose or nostrils of a horse.
E.
घुण to roll, to turn, and अच् and टाप् aff.

m. (-णी)
A hog.
E.
घोणा nose or snout, and इनि aff.

f. (-ण्टा)
1 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.)
2 The betel-nut tree: see गुवाक.
3 A timber tree, (Schrebera swietenioides^1.)
E.
घुट to resist, affix अच्, and नुम् inserted.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.
